They are knowledgable about the menu and take into account any special occasions and dietary restrictions. Il Terrazzo really feels like a special place! The manager was kind and came by each table to ask how everyone’s meal was, and I saw him helping bus some tables as well, this really shows that they care, and it was great to see this added touch. Okay the FOOD! WOW! I’ve eaten a lot of amazing meals in my life, and this was one of them. The ordered the lamb chop appetizer for my meal and the flavors of the root vegetables and the char on the lamb made it feel like it was roasting away all day, the flavor was incredible! My husband got the venison and he was raving about his dish and how well all the flavors flowed. Highly recommend getting the mussels, the portion size was very generous, they were so large and buttery, and when I asked the manager, he said they were locally sourced. Overall, this restaurant hit it out of the park on every level! I could say so much more, but you MUST eat here!

It was very noisy and the server asked me to repeat myself many times, and since I've been here before and trusted the safety of the crossover contamination, I didn't choose to speak up about it. We then went on to order a usual favorite and risotto was asked to be a replacement for the pasta, and again there was still no question about any intolerances. When the dish arrived, it looked so different than every other time I've had their silky, incredible risotto. Unfortunately, this time it was so so dry and tasted like it came from a microwave. The tuna from the tonno dish was also uncharacteristically dry and tasted like it was canned, when before it had been so moist and truly delicious. Both meals and the appetizer were slathered in a spicy mayo that overpowered the dish, making it so it was hard to distinguish any other flavors. After hearing the restaurant had changed hands since I'd last been, I still wanted to believe this was just maybe a bad night for the chef, but because of the price - which was well worth the quality in the past, as well as the portion size - I don't think I'm willing to risk it again and must sadly say goodbye to a favorite spot to bring visiting family/have date nights.

Il Terrazzo is located in a beautiful historic building, creating a unique and charming atmosphere from the moment you walk in. The restaurant has a warm, lively ambiance, and the staff are enthusiastic, attentive, and welcoming.

I highly recommend making a reservation in advance, as it’s clearly a very popular place.

The food is excellent, with authentic Italian flavors and high-quality ingredients. One thing to keep in mind, though, is that the portions are exceptionally large—more American-sized than traditional Italian. While everything tasted delicious, it felt just a little over the top. My advice would be to order only a main course or just a starter, as that’s more than enough for most people.

That said, we had a wonderful dining experience and thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Definitely a restaurant worth visiting when you’re in Victoria.
